title: A Safehouse for the Border
author: Lena Winterbourne
blurb: Ines Thornbury, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
